By supernatural power, however — no offense.
[32a5] Going about at the wrong time //
(<s>Vin</s> 2,4,81) On visiting households.
// Starting from the fourth [watch], at the wrong time — in approaching a household.

children.text: / tanmukhikayā ca saṃghopanimantraṇenāsmad ānāgamanavaśāt pariveṣo 'tipātya ity apariprāpya dātari tṛtīyaprabhṛtau /
children.translated_text: And through an invitation from the <s>Saṃgha</s> with him [as intermediary] — 'The serving has been postponed due to our not having come' — having not yet reached the donor — from the third [time] onward.
Visiting households // Completed.
(<s>Vin</s> 2,4,82) On nighttime visits to the royal court.
When it has not yet dawned.
This is [defined as] the non-rising of the final dawn.

When connected with the dwelling-place of the inner palace.
[32b1] Even when not engaged in that [purpose].
Per each night.
From the inspection of its bolt onward — that [marks] the beginning.
Likewise for the royal court and the city.
And by [being in] the area of the royal court.
By [being in] the city — a <s>duṣkṛta</s>.
If for that purpose.
If a second [night] — herein [is] a fault.
Not when [constrained] by the force of kings, queens, princes, ministers, impediments, or <s>Vinaya</s>-discipline.
One should not enter the royal court without being announced.
Nighttime visits to the royal court //
(<s>Vin</s> 2,4,83) On treating the training rules as trivial.

children.text: / [32b2]vartamāne prātimokṣoddeśe nubhūtavatadvayasyāsaṃvignena manasā saṃprati mayā jñātam ayam apy atra dharmo vidyata ity asyoktau /
children.translated_text: [32b2] While the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> recitation is proceeding — one who has not experienced both [understanding and practice] — with an unagitated mind — [saying] 'Now I know — this <s>Dharma</s> too exists here' — in this statement of his.
In the recitation with another's expression — toward the shared [rule] — a <s>duṣkṛta</s>.
And in the <s>sūtra</s>-context — when [the rule] that was not stated is being spoken.
No offense — toward the non-shared [rule].
They should admonish one who approaches the hearing of the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> recitation disrespectfully.
Treating the training rules as trivial //
(<s>Vin</s> 2,4,84) On procuring a needle-case.
[32b3] In the making and causing-to-be-made of a needle-case of tooth, bone, or horn.
No offense — in obtaining [one already] made and in using [it].
One should not accept a confession without having inquired about its integrity.
If [the person] has [committed an offense] without having been instructed — [that is counted as] not having been instructed.
In the subsequent [rules] too — this [applies], connected with the five [types of] cutting off.
By uprooting — in the second [type].

children.text: / pañca tūlāni śālmalamārkaṃ kāśamayaṃ vaukamaira[33a1]kañ ca /
/ khādyakam iha dehi pānakaṃ bho[33a4]janaṃ bhūyo cetyādi tasmin* bhikṣvantare vā vyapadeśapravṛttabhikṣuṇyavasthānakartṛ /
/ na cet tanmukhikayā tatjñātinā vā nimantraṇakam /
/ āgamayasva tāvad bhagini yāvad bhikṣavo bhuñjata ity anājñaptāyāṃ tasyāṃ bhikṣuṇā yena kena cid asahabhujā pitṛprabhṛtibhikṣunimantraṇaka[33a5]bhuktau /
/ śrāddhasya vighātaś cedd asya dāne kula[33b1]śikṣāsamvṛtiṃ dadyuḥ /
/ dadyād asya yācamānebhyo bālebhyaḥ piṇḍapātrāt pūpikām asakalāṃ /
/ dattāśikṣāsamvṛteḥ kulāt prāktaddānād animantritaś ca pratigṛhya khādanī[33b2]yabhojanīyayor utsṛjyakakaṭikāmūlakaharitakam avighāty abhyavahṛtau /
/ araṇye bahirārāmasya pratigṛhya khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyam cābhyavaharet* /

// vanaviṣayagataṃ caturthaṃ pratideśanīyaṃ // 2,5,4 //
// samāptāni ca prātideśanīyāni //
/ [33b4] tathā nivasanaṃ nivasīta yathā parimaṇḍalaṃ saṃsthitaṃ syāt* /
/ tathā cīvaraṃ prāvṛṇvīta yathā syādyaṃ trayaṃ syāt* /
/ na sarvakāyaṃ samavadhāya / << napādau pādām ādhāya //>>
/ na bhūyaskāmatayaudanena sūpikaṃ sūpikena caudanaṃ pratichādayeta /
/ triḥ prakṣālya pātramārṣabhir gāthābhir abhimantrapātrodakaṃ dadyāt* /
/ na puruṣadaghnād ūrdhaṃ vṛkṣasyādhirohed anyatrāpadaḥ / << śaikśāsamāpta / samāptaś ca vibhaṅgaḥ >> atha bhikṣuṇīvibhaṅgaḥ / pārājayikam /
/ paṃsaś cet tadānīm* tatra vijñāyamānan tayaitat(a) /
/ pratyupasthitaṃ sevāyāṃ raktan tasyāṃ pumāṃsaṃ tatprāpyatāyāṃ /
/ auddhatyasya raktena sārddhaṃ raktayā karaṇe sthūlaṃ /
/ nātaḥ paṇyena dāsyāḥ preṣaṇasya bahir bhāvaḥ /
/ na raktād araktāyāḥ [35a1] kiñcitkasvīkāre doṣa iti bhikṣuṇībodhane /

children.translated_text: The end of the day is [defined as] when the sun is setting.
At night, when outside the <s>varṣaka</s> (rain-retreat boundary), in the event [of being absent] —
Night-separation.
During the day —

children.text:
/ cīvared ekākinī jñātigṛhabhuktinimittaṃ durbhikṣe labdhāyāṃ jñātibhir
sārddhaṃ sambandhopavicārasamvṛtau /
children.translated_text: Regarding the robe — [a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>] alone, for the purpose of eating at a relative's house during famine, when [food] has been obtained, together with relatives, when the investigation of the connection is concluded —
They should give it to her.
Day-separation.
Regarding conduct on the road —
Descent onto the road.
In crossing a river to the other bank —
Upon reaching the other bank, with the arms.
A large [river] — [a <s>duṣkṛta</s> offense if crossed] from this side.
A <s>duṣkṛta</s> for [crossing] to the other side of a canal.
Crossing a river.
Regarding ordination —
The preceptress approved by the <s>gaṇa</s> (community), of one whose king has relinquished [authority], of one permitted by her own [family] —
Regarding killing [i.e., when there is threat to life] —
In the capacity of preceptress —
They know this.
Ordination [of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>].
Regarding the taking up of a deceased person's property —
No offense for [taking] what belongs to the <s>Saṃgha</s>.
If with little effort.
Taking up [deceased's property].
Regarding expulsion beyond the boundary —
Expulsion.

children.text: / ratnapratyākhyānam idaṃ tulyatvam anyaśramaṇānāṃ tatra brahmacaryacariṣyatva(ṃ)m ity asyāvacanapravṛtter aviratau /
children.translated_text: Renunciation of [the Three] Jewels, [declaring] 'this is equality with other <s>śramaṇas</s>' — when there is engagement in non-restraint through the operation of not saying 'I shall practice the holy life therein' —
As with the operation of splitting the <s>Saṃgha</s>.
And those beginning with the subsequent [offenses].
Renunciation.
Regarding the prosecution of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who have gone [astray] through desire and so forth —
In adjudicating together with <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> regarding quarrel, dispute, contention, and controversy —
The quarrel-procedure.
Regarding a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who dwells in mingled [contact] —
Of the two [faults] that are causes of agitation, profligacy, and timidity —
That pertaining to association with women.
In instigating such association —
Instigation.
Of the group of four [offenses] pertaining to <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, beginning with splitting the <s>Saṃgha</s> —

Thus the group of four beginning with splitting the <s>Saṃgha</s>.
The <s>saṃghāvaśeṣa</s> [offenses for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>] are completed.

<s>Naissargika</s> [offenses].
The group of ten.
Regarding gold, silver, coins, buying and selling, weaving of binding threads, double cutting, maturing, and storing —
Thus the group of ten beginning with gold and silver.
Beginning with the washing [of a robe] for a <s>bhikṣu</s> — thereafter regarding acceptance —
Thus acceptance.
Having given to a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> —
One should not wear divine sandalwood.
In keeping an extra bowl beyond one day —
Keeping a bowl.
Every half-month, on a proper day, [the robe] not formally designated, or [keeping] what should be designated —
Non-designation.
In the dissolution of the <s>kaṭhina</s> [robe privileges] before the last day of <s>Phālguna</s> —
No offense when [it is] for the purpose of a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who has been robbed by a thief.
<s>Kaṭhina</s> dissolution.
In non-dissolution —
The same [offense applies].
<s>Kaṭhina</s> non-dissolution.
In requesting gold or silver —
Requesting jewels.
In designating for consumption a robe obtained for another purpose, having converted it to food —
That pertaining to consuming robes.
And for the purpose of robes, bedding, and rain-retreat [needs] —
Of anyone whatsoever.
That pertaining to consuming robes and such.
When a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> solicits for the sake of the common people and diverts [the goods] to herself —
Designation for the purpose of the common people.
And for the purpose of the <s>Saṃgha</s> —
Designation for the purpose of the <s>Saṃgha</s>.
In releasing bound property for the purpose of obtaining acceptance of one's word —
Release.
In appropriating a garment worth a hundred <s>palas</s> or a twentieth of a <s>kārṣāpaṇa</s> and above —
Sharing of a heavy garment.
And of [a garment] up to five <s>palikas</s> —

Sharing of a light garment.
The <s>naissargika</s> [offenses] are completed. Seventy-two.
<s>Śuddhaka-prāyaścittika</s> [offenses for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>].
Regarding the ten beginning with the unapproved, pertaining to extraction, succession, preparation, and sitting-standing — excluding what pertains to the unrecovered under-garment.
A <s>bhikṣu</s>'s presenting food supplies to a female renunciant that is proper —
Even in the status of being a wife —
And the acceptance by her.
Not to be excluded from the shared bed — of a young son —
Of one who has obtained propriety.
The giving to her.
Regarding ordination and full ordination —
Of one who has not completed twelve years [of age] —
Of one who has been self-ordained —
Deficient attendance.
They should give the two proprieties: presentation to the assembly and presentation to the fire-assembly.
In presenting to one who is capable —
Upon completion, full ordination is [given] at twelve years of age.
No other [<s>bhikṣuṇī</s>] should request.
In presenting to the assembly without having first obtained propriety —
Presentation without having obtained propriety.
Of an unmeasured assembly, in another's [jurisdiction] —
Non-fire presentation.
In giving full ordination to a married woman less than twelve years [after marriage] —
Ordaining one under twelve years.
Of another [unmarried woman] under twenty —
Ordaining one under twenty years.
As preceptress, of one not given the two trainings —
In transgressing the fortnightly [observance] —
When it has not been practiced by her —
Ordaining one whose training is unlearned.
When [the training] has been practiced — no [offense].
Not ordaining one whose training is completed.

children.text: / sa cen me cīvaraṃ dadāsi tataḥ svopasaṃpādayāmīty upasaṃpatprekṣayā vacane /
children.translated_text: When saying with a view to ordination: 'If you give me a robe, then I shall ordain you' —
Bartering the <s>Dharma</s>.
By showing compatibility with ordination, abbreviating the household [life], but not ordaining —
Deceptive speech.
In ordaining — for a year —
Multiplicity of lineage.
Of one not permitted by her husband —
Thus the group pertaining to accepting the unauthorized.
Of an adulteress —
Of a pregnant woman —
Of one stricken with grief —
Even in ordaining a quarrelsome woman —
Thus that pertaining to the group of those requiring a waiting period and above.
In not supporting those who have been ordained and fully ordained —
In not removing [the candidate] when an obstacle has been seen —
In not training [her] —
In not attending upon the two who are sick —
Of one's own students —
Thus that pertaining to neglect.
In carrying a lac-ball between the privately serviceable [parts] —
She should not strain against the current.
She should not insert semen at the vaginal opening.
She should not make a side-binding with a leather strip.
Nor [bind] the breasts with a loom-strip.
No obstruction by means of a <s>Sugata</s>-insert.
This is an illustration.
Thus non-coital sexual acts.
In internally washing the genitalia beyond two finger-joints —
The substitute is indeed non-coital.
In giving a palm-slap therein —
Thus that pertaining to the rule-violation of non-coital acts.
Regarding the cause and instrument of hair removal [of pubic hair] beyond [what is proper] —
Thus the preparation of what is privately serviceable.
In standing with a householder in a concealed [place] —
The condition of this is concealment by walls, enclosures, cloths, thickets, or darkness.
With a <s>bhikṣu</s> —
In an open place, [facing] east —
[Or facing] north —
A lesser offense when she is accompanied by another.
For a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when she has a companion or a <s>śrāmaṇerikā</s> following behind.
In conveying a whispered message from a householder —
In accepting — this is his opinion —
Of a <s>bhikṣu</s> —
And from this —
In learning a craft from a householder —
In teaching him or her —
In releasing from the bond of blows, wounds, and beatings —
By a pretext —
Therefore no offense when the matter is truthful.
Thus those pertaining to non-touching contact.
In retaining offspring —
Thus attachment to childbirth.
In bowing at night inside a house without notifying the house-master —
No offense when [the house] is under the authority of a woman, upon notifying her.
At night, bowing in a concealed [place] without examining [it first] —
In resting without another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> —
No offense if she has been murdered or similar.
The actions of leaning, reaching out, and circumventing the door —
And together with a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, one (offense)
In arranging a shared bed —

children.text: / anāpattir anayā sārddham anekayāpi kṛtāvaraṇatāyāṃ vṛśyādinopasthitasmṛtir anāsvādane 'ṅgasaṃsparśasyācalamañ ce prākṛte saṃstare vā /
children.translated_text: No offense if, together with her — even with more than one — when a screen has been made, the awareness is maintained through a fan or similar, there is no savoring of bodily contact, and if [contact occurs] it is on an ordinary mat —
A <s>duṣkṛta</s> when it is possible [to avoid it].
Thus the prohibition of cohabitation in shared quarters.
Regarding the cause of a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'s bodily anointing by a <s>śikṣamāṇā</s> —
By a <s>śrāmaṇerikā</s>, by a laywoman —
[Doing this is like] belonging to a non-Buddhist sect.
Regarding the cause of squatting [for bodily care] —
In anointing one's own body with fragrant substances —
With sesame-cake —
Thus that pertaining to personal grooming.
In bathing with one who clings [to one's] hand —
Thus water-enjoyment.
For the purpose of adornment, [use] of <s>uśīra</s> (vetiver root) that has been commissioned —
And of pillows called <s>phaṇa</s> (hood-shaped), <s>kūrva</s>, and <s>trya</s> —
When engaged in household ornamentation —
Thus that pertaining to adornment.
Dancing with any limb whatsoever —
In singing —
Wherever and however, in vocal modulation with that intention —
In playing a musical instrument —
Thus that pertaining to excitement.
In using an umbrella that has become [merely] for enjoyment —
And sandals —
No offense during the rain-retreat for the protection of bedding and seats.
In experiencing a couch and personal attendance —
Thus that pertaining to playful behavior.
Sitting in a household seat without invitation —
Thus presumptuous intrusion.
Having eaten, in departing from the householder's seat for hearing and giving the <s>Dharma</s> without relinquishing [the seat] and without looking at the householder —
The limit of the investigation of the abandoned secret.
Thus deceptive conduct.
In cutting thread —

children.text: / anāpatti[ḥ] loṭhakāṣṭhañ ca kasyārthe pratigupte pradeśe /
children.translated_text: No offense for the purpose of a lac-ball or stick, in a concealed place.
In appropriating a thief of the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> community —
Of one who has made a sale of food —
And of a woman who is disruptive to the household —
She should not engage in liquor-production.
She should not operate a drinking-house.
In cooking this —

children.text: / anāpattiḥ bhikṣusaṃghasya ācāryasabrahmacāriṇām arthe pratigupte pradeśe /
children.translated_text: No offense for the purpose of the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>, teachers, and fellow celibates, in a concealed place.
Thus that pertaining to a laywoman's craft.
In eating more after having eaten, without rising from the seat —
Thus the gluttonous behavior.
Of garlic —
Thus the enjoyment of an unseemly odor.
In not wearing a menstrual cloth —
Not placing [one] that has been tied with a cord —
Washing and dyeing it from time to time —
And regarding the water-cloth —
She should wear these.
In having a robe washed by a washerman —
Thus that pertaining to breach of modesty.
In giving a renunciant's robe to a laywoman for veiling purposes —
Thus that pertaining to disrespect for the banner of the <s>Dharma</s>.
In exchanging the upper robe with a <s>bhikṣu</s> —
Thus that pertaining to exchanging the banner [of the order].
In creating jealousy regarding complexion —
And jealousy regarding dwelling, gain, and the <s>Dharma</s> —
Thus that pertaining to jealousy.
In expelling [someone] from a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'s rain-retreat —
In whatever manner, of a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> —
And of one who has previously entered, from the interior of the house —
Thus that pertaining to expulsion.
In reproaching with ill-will and so forth —
Thus that pertaining to harassment.
In taking an oath —
Thus that pertaining to the display of the two opposites.

children.text: / dattvāsanaṃ prati sammodya pṛṣṭāgamābhiyogam avakāśaṃ kārayet /
/ anāpattiḥ glānye sphuṭatve ca nīlatṛṇaiḥ sarvasya /

// payasaḥ parakulato vijñaptasyātmārtham abhyavahṛtau /
/ aglānayā /
/ vijñaptāpanayāduṣkṛtam /
/ taddhinavanītaḥ sarpis tailaṃ madhuthāni tamāṃ samatsyavallūrāṇāñ ca /
/ nāto nyalabdhāv nya vijñapane hrāsaḥ /
/ [37b4] lūhasa ca /
/ tatgate cāsya labdhau /
/ duṣkṛtatvam asya /
/ sairgaḥ //
// prātideśanīyāni /

/ [37b5] tatpakṣāṇāṃ mānasam /
dhāraṇaṃ vipravāsañ ca sparśam agner nivārite /
bhojanaṃ vījāghātañ ca deśe ca harite śuceḥ //
utsargaṃ vṛkṣarohañc a śaikṣā uddeśayos saha /
ratnasparśainabhuktvā ca rajatasānnidhyanānnayoḥ //
bhūmiprarohaghātābhyāmṛtsṛjyāntaṃ ca putragam /
prāvṛṣyekatravasanaṃ poṣadhaḥ sapravāraṇaḥ //
ityādy asyāntabhāg liṅga [38a1] / /anāśāyatakāntārikāgatāṃ tālikām ālaṃbya
tatsthaṃ vā sūtrakam /
/ tisraḥ parivṛttayor dvau prahāram ity aparam /
/ asaṃpattau gaṇḍīdānena saṃbodhanasya mahāsannipāte yamalaśaṃkhayor āpūrṇam /
/ saṃbhāvini kāryasya kāle 'vaśiṣṭe yathāsukhaṃ karaṇaṃ dattatridaṇḍake /
/ śailakuḍyastambhavṛkṣaprākāraprāgbhārātimārgodapānādau pratidiśaṃ saṃlakṣya tatjñaiḥ bhikṣubhiḥ parikīrttite sannidhau saṃghasya sthāvare cihne karmaṇaḥ [38a6] karaṇam /
/ yujyate dvayoḥ sīmnor ekena vacasā bandho mokṣo vā /
/ kathaṃcid apy aśaktau saṃghasya vā tatra gamanaṃ [38b3] tasya vā mañcenānayanam /
/ pareṇa pañcadaśyāṃ gṛhītatve bhikṣor muñcainaṃ bhikṣuṃ sabrahmacāryeṣasmākam iti brūyuḥ /
/ amuktāvasty asmākam anena sārddhaṃ kiñcid eva karaṇīya[38b5]m iti sādyaṃ /
/ na vicikitsitaṃ niścitaṃ vā kalpamānatve 'nutthiter doṣasya kartṛ /
/ anekatvā ekatra vasuni prajñapteḥ / yāvad eva taddoṣaḥ /
/ vātāyanañ ca vi tṛtīye ūrdham bahissamvṛtam antarviśālaṃ sādhu /
/ mauñjaṃ sāṇaṃ vālvajaṃ paṭṭikā vetravaibhaṅgukam iti /
/ ūrṇā śaṇaḥ karpyāso natukāni patravaibhaṅgukañ ca /
/ kākapadakānā[39b5]m antaro ntare yathārtham avasthāpanāya dānam /
/ sanaiḥ aduḥkhanārthamāḍhakaṃ chitter veṣṭitāyāś ca natukaiḥ /

/ ya āyusman idaṃ cedañ ca karoti kiṃ* tasya bhavati sāpattiko natvāyusmatedaṃ cedaṃ ca kṛtaṃ kṛtam evaṃ [40a2] saty āyusmān* sāpattiko nāham āyusmann eko pi tu sarvasaṃgho nenārthenāṅgatāvattvam āyusmān svām āpattiṃ* yathādharmaṃ pratikuru kin te kariṣyati sarvasaṃgha iti prakrameṇa darśanapathe śiṣṭānām icchāyāṃ deśayet* /
/ sarve cet* pañcadaśyām āpattim* pratīyur vimatim vā svapratikriyārtham āvāsāntare kañcit prasthāpayeyuḥ pratigṛhī[40a3]tṛsaṃvatyartham /
/ darśana bhikṣuṇām aṅga tāvad āyusmanta[40a4]s tvaritatvaritam āgacchatām āryasaṃghasya poṣadhaḥ pravaraṇā vā pāñcadaśika iti vacanaṃ /
/ trikam ardhayojanaṃ krośam ardhakro[40a6]śaṃ pariṣaṇḍām vā /
/ nākṛtapoṣadhaḥ pravāraṇas taddine prajñāyamānasv ata(da)ḥ sthānāt prakrāmen na cet tadaiva tadvadhe prāptiḥ kalikṛtbhyo vimuktir anuprāptiḥ [40b1] sat*vṛttānā<<m ity e>>tat parāyanatvam vā /
/ nābhikṣukaṃ sabhikṣukād asahitaḥ śiṣṭair anyatrāpadaḥ kāyacittaprasrabdhivaśatā ta vā /
/ tat*rūpatāyāṃ pratyayasya sadvṛttoddeśavantam upadiśya vāsaṃ tatrāvatāre niyuñjīt* /
/ kalpatāpaścād āgatānām arthe punaḥ karaṇam anayoḥ /
/ yaḥ kaści[t*] [40b5] nānādhīṣṭho na cet tanmukhikayā nirgatiḥ /
/ ardhacandrākāreṇa pra[41a1] // kṣiriṇyākāreṇa vā dharmaśravaṇasaṃgatiṃ* prajñapayet* prakṣīriṇyāṃ /
/ muhūrttaṃ sthaviro gregataṃ tūṣṇīm āga<<ma>>yyātra dharmaṃ bhāṣetānyam vādhīcched vada bhikṣo dharmaṃ <</>>
/ tīrthyañ ca pratyavatiṣṭhamānaṃ sunigṛhītam adarśayat kopam ananusūyam* /
/ vihārasvāmidevatārthañ ca gāthābhāṣaṇe bhikṣūṇāṃ niyogasya vacanaṃ /
/ adya śuklapakṣasya pratipad vihārasvāmino vihāradevatānāṃ cārthāya gāthāṃ bhā<<ṣa>>dhvam iti /
/ evaṃ nāma dānapati śvo bhikṣusaṃghaṃ bhaktenopanimantrayate taṃ bhadanta kalyā[41a5]ṇaiḥ manobhiḥ pratyanukampāntām iti /
/ nāvicāryānāgamyya poṣadhaṃ śūnyo yam ita sīmānaṃ badhnīyuḥ /
/ nordhaṃ madhyato rdhatṛtīyayojanāntāt sīmno bandhasya rūḍhiḥ /
/ [41b5] niravadyaṃ srāddhasya pradhānasya ca tuṣṭisaṃbhāvanāyām ācārānuśrāvaṇam* /

/ so ktagandhaiś cāṅgerīpaṭalakagate śukle vāsasy upanikṣiptāḥ śalākā vṛddhānte niveśyā yañ cāyaṃ cāsminn āvāse kriyākāro yo yusmākam utsahate tena kriyākāreṇāsminn āvāse varṣāvastuṃ sa śalākāṃ grihṇātu na ca vaḥ kenacid antarvarṣe saṃghamadhye raṇam utpā[42a2]dayitavyo yo vaḥ kasyacit kiñcij jānāti sa idānīṃ* vadanta yo <<vo>> ntarvarṣe saṃghe raṇam utpādayiṣyati tasya saṃgha uttara upaparīkṣitavyaṃ matsyata iti bhikṣūn vedayeta /
/ naivāsikānā[42a3]m asy etad ante śanaiḥ sthāpanama /
/ gaṇayitvā pravedanam iyadbhir bhikṣubhir asminn āvāse śalākā gṛhīteti /

/ anta tasya tattāḍakakuñjikena purataḥ sthitvā rocanopakramaṃ
sthavirāmuko vihāraḥ salābhaḥ sacīvariko gṛhāṇeti yathāguṇam* /
/ jñātvoddeśam astūpasaṃghārthe gatasya gantryā bhāgitvaṃ [42a4] vṛkṣamūlaharitasārdhalasthaṇḍileṣv api yathāvṛddhikoddeśaḥ /
/ na sasave py atra sāṃghike tiṣṭhed āprāsādapuṣkiriṇīdvārakoṣṭhakapariṣaṇḍacaṃkramasthānavṛkṣāt* /
/ varṣopagamane syuḥ kecid āgantava iti vastu śayanāsanañ ca sthāpayeyuḥ /
/ pūrvāhṇe kvacit pāṭhasvādhyāyāvasthānacaṃkramāṇāṃ kvacid madhyāhne paratrānyatra <<pātra>>cīvarasthāpanam āvāso paratra rātrāv ity asya yogaḥ /
/ ayam amutrartāv ahaurātre tadavayave vā bhaviṣyaty ayam amutrāyām ācāryasya bhaviṣyaty ayam upādhyāyasya sā[42b3]rdham vihāriṇo yam ayam antevāsina ālaptakāder ayam iti vihārān nuddiśeyuḥ /
/ na sāṃghikam ava[42b4]naddhaṃ nāśanadharmaṇe śucinā śrāmaṇerāya śayanāsanaṃ kaścid dadyāt* /
/ na vaṣ kenacit sāṃghikaṃ śayanāsanam vinā pratyāstaraṇena paribhoktavyaṃ na kalpapratyāstaraṇena na malapratyāstaraṇeneti vedayeta /
/ [42b5] samayam utkramya paribhuktāvāchindyād ārocya niḥśraye niḥśritasyānyasya saṃghe /
/ amukena dānapatināmukena vaiyyapṛtyakareṇāmukena gocaragrāmakena svaḥ saṃgho varṣā upagamiṣyatīty ārocayet* /

/ anunmāditvaprativinoditvayoḥ kaukṛtyasyānyasya ca duḥkhadaurmanasyasya
sukhasaumanasyasya cotyāditvānurakṣitvayoḥ
glānopasthāyakatvasya ca [42b6] sabrahmacāriṣu bhūteḥ
pratyāśaṃsanenāvāsaṃ gocarañ ca piṇḍakabhaiṣajyadātror
avalokyopagamanam* /
/ na yasminn abhikṣukatvam akapāṭakatvañ ca sahitam* /
/ laṅghayed etad bhaktabhaiṣajyopasthāyakābhāve śaktau tair vinā yāpayitum* /
/ na kurvīt* nāsty asyaikapoṣadhatāyām āvāsayor utthānam* /
/ na nāvyutsṛjya prāptapṛthivīm upanibaddhām vā bhūmisthe sthire saṃjanato ntarāpayāyitvam* /
/ dhvansas tad dṛśam abhiniḥsṛtyādharmapakṣasaṃkrāntāv aruṇodgatau [43a6] na saṃdigdhatāyām* /
/ anāśaṃkyam anākṣiptatvaṃ tīrthyasya dṛṣṭer vivecanārthaṃ jñāteḥ karaṇīyenāgamādhigamayor ātmanaḥ kāṃkṣāvinodanārthaṃ gamanāyaitatkṛteḥ /
/ yataḥ prabhṛti kelāyanam iyatbhiḥ divasaiḥ saṃghasya pravāraṇā bhaviṣyati yuṣmākam ārocitam bhavatv iti /
/ adya sarvarātrikaṃ dharmaśravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati tatra yuṣmābhiḥ sāmagrī deyeti gocarārocya sūtravinayamātrakadharair adhiṣṭacaturdaśyāṃ sarvarātrikadharmaśravaṇadāpanam* /
/ parasyāntaiḥ prākkarmato dhamyayā viniścayakathayā rātrer atināmanam* /
/ sarvasaṃghena prativārite etat tvasya saṃghe nivedanam* /

/ svakyena vastunā vastapravāraṇam ārabheta vacanato gṛhītvā<<ta>>ḥ [43b6] saṃghena labhyaṃ bhadantā evaṃ rūpeṇāpi vastunā varṣoṣitam
bhikṣusaṃghaṃ pravārayitum iti /

/ aśakyatāyām avasthātuṃ bhāgaprāptaṃ bhikṣum avalokayet
gaṇapravāraṇena /

/ na haiva vayam āyusmann ity arthaṃ sanniṣaṇṇāḥ sannipattitāḥ kaccid āyusman* vastu sthāpayen na putgalam ity api tu śīlaviśuddhyarthaṃ poṣadha ukto bhagavatā dharmathiśuddhyarthaṃ pravāraṇā saāced ākāṃ[44a2]kṣasi pravārayeti /

/ putgagalaṃ sthāpayen na na vastv iti vastu sthāpayet* putgalañ ceti
abhaṅgaḥ pratīṣṭaiḥ vyapalāpe sthāpanasya pratīṣṭatāyā sthāpitasya vā /
/ naivaṃvidhaṃ kiñcid astītivāde mṛṣātvam atra pūrvasyāsya vā /
/ kalikṛtāñ cet bhikṣūṇām āganam upagatāḥ śṛṇuyuḥ dvitripoṣadhātikrāntiś cet pravārayeyuḥ /
/ karaṇadharmaśravaṇadā(da)nam ity eṣāṃ pralobhanāni prayuñjīran* asaṃpattāv ātmībhāvasya poṣadhaṃ kurvīran* maṇḍalakeṣu /
/ nanu yuṣmākam adya pravāraṇeti bruvāṇā[44a4]nām āgamayatāyuṣmantāgantukā yūyaṃ naivāsikā anenārtheneti prativadeyuḥ /
/ yathā trayam evam āstīrṇasya paraṃparabhojanam api nirdoṣaṃ gaṇabhojanaman āmantryagrāmapraveśaś cīvaravijñapanañ ca /
/ tasmai dadīta jñapty ādhāvanasyūtirañjaneṣv asau pūrvaṃgamaḥ syāt* /
/ niṣṭhitaṃ saṃpattau dvitrāṇāṃ svayaṃ sūcīpadakānāṃ dānam* /
/ ādānasvayaṃkṛti tad anteṣv āstā[44b4]riṣyāmy āstṛṇomy āstṛtaṃ mayeti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ cittasyotpādanam* /
/ śvo ham āyuṣmantaḥ kaṭhinam āstariṣyāmi yuṣmābhiḥ svakasvakāni cīvarāṇy uddhartavyāniīti sāmagryām ārocanam* /
/ gandhapuṣpārcitaṃ surabhidhūpadhūpita cāṃgeripaṭalakastham ekaṃ trivānekam ādāya vṛddhā[44b5]nte vasthitenāstṛtes sampādanaṃ pratipadiḥ /
/ sādhv āstṛtaṃ suṣṭhv āstṛtaṃ yo tra lābhaś cānuśaṃsaś ca so 'smākamitītaraḥ /
/ traye kariṣyamāṇasyaitat saṃsthānam āśāsamucchede prārabdhanaṣṭau niṣṭhāna iti /
/ āśruter asminn ananubhūtevan taṃ pratyanuvṛttir anuśaṃse /
/ kṛte py atretarair eṣām āvāse lābhe rhatvam* /
/ bhavati chandadānavaśāt sahitena karaṇīyasya śiṣṭaiḥ kṛtau kṛtatvam* /
/ tasmād a[45a4]datvā cchandaṃ svapnasamāpatyoḥ saṃniṣaṇṇe syānutthānam āstārasyoddhṛteś ca prāk śruvaṇāt* /
/ yat tad āstṛtya pṛthak sīmakaraṇe cāsya sthānam* /
/ nainaṃ sāṃghikam akhaṭamaṃcapīṭhamapratyāstṛtamatenāniṣādāt saṃvaraṇaṃ vā dattāntarddhānam upabhuñjīta /
/ pañcānāṃ labheḥ bhājane karaṇam adyalābho bhājayiṣyate tatra yuṣmābhiḥ sannipatitavyam ity ārocanaṃ saṃghe /
/ naikatvam arddhasya suvarutā ca labdher anarhapraveśe kāraṇaṃ /
/ uṣitatvaṃ bahutaram uṣitasya tatkālake lābhe hānāyāsyāvṛttau mṛtyau ca /
/ kasyacit tataḥ saṃghavṛddhanavakayoḥ dānaṃ tad ākhyaṃ /
/ sīmāntarikāt sthalagne kāye nyatra vā yātāmā[46a3]krāntis tāvad gatānāṃ /
/ antargṛhasthatve pātracīvarasya yasmai gṛhapatinā dānaṃ tasyaiśitvam /
/ yat tena sā[46a5]rddham avasthitaṃ tasya deyatvaṃ grāhyatā vā na tasyaiva /
/ ratnā dīpitvaṃ saṃbhāvane yāvadbhya etat tāvatsu nāvakarmikasya viniyogaḥ samaṃ sa glānopasthāyakrātvatadgāmitvaṃ pariskāraṣaṭkasya nādhiṣṭheyatvam /
/ hāyate glānasyoktoktena dāne yathoktena dāne yathoktaṃ kāryatvaṃ /
/ sa cced anyad etat tadaṃśatvenārthiriktatve pi na ced evam eva buddhe muktānāṃ /

/ yathārham anyasya sāṃghikasya nikṣepabhājanaṃ bhojanāni kṣetragṛhāpaṇaśayanāsanāyapaskāralohanāpitakulālatakṣā ca varuoḍabhāṇḍadāsīdāsakarmakarapauruṣayagomahiṣyajaiḍakabhaiṣajyabuddhaśāstrapustakānāṃ susādhyalekhā[46b3]nāṃ prathamārhatvaṃ /
/ na rajakena raktam araktaṃ vā vastraṃ śocayet /
/ na medhyāṃ caṃkrame vā raṅgakarma kuryuḥ /

/ bhaṅgo mṛṣṭer atra kalpaḥ /
/ pānīye na bollitatvaṃ /
/ avaśyāya pariśudhe śakyataratvaṃ hastam ardhena bhagasya /
/ [47a5] nivāsitasyoparikāyasya bandhanam /
/ paṭṭikayākhothikayāṅkuñcakena muñcikayā vā /
/ nānābharaṇakalāpakāt duṇḍhubhakāvaidehakāsu varṇasūtrañ ca /
/ tadvac citraṃ /
/ nānāstarāyāṃ bhūmau cīvaraṃ nikṣipet /
/ kālena kālam asya śocanaṃ rañjanañ ca /
/ lagnasya kaṣāyodakena kṣodamiśreṇa gate ma[47b2]yitvā mandamandam apanayanaṃ pūyaśoṇitasya ca /
/ kālena kālam asya śocanaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ rañjanañ ca /
/ dharmyayā vā kathayādhvani gacched āryeṇa vā tūṣṇīmbhāvena /
/ na vinaitayā durlabhākūpapānīye deśe cāgārikāṃ caret /
/ prasphoṭitacīvaro dhvagaḥ [47b5] snātavāṃ prakṣālitapāṇipādo vā gṛhītapānīyaḥ poccito pānakes tricīvaraṃ prāvṛtya śānteryāpatho vihāraṃ praviśet /
/ pidhvīyatāṃ dvāraṃ na deyaṃ mṛgayate nivāryo gṛhṇāna iti pratyā[47b6]yitasya pratīcchyāvyupekṣitavatopahṛtau viśvāsavastutāñ copanītena mamaivāyaṃ sahāya ityādi pratipādanayā dāsyatvam /
/ pariṣaṇḍādānam antasya cīvare dhvasto pratividhānaṃ ārāpadakais tatsaṃgrahaḥ /
/ parivāsyābhyavakāśe vṛkṣādy upari saptāṣṭānyahāni pañcāṣātīty aparaṃ śocayitvā śavacīvaraṃ bhuñjīt* /
/ pravedite smaśaniko ham ity upanimantritaḥ praveśaṃ vihārakulayoḥ paribhogañ cānutsṛṣṭasvīkārasya śmaśaniko bhajet* /
/ ūrṇāṃ saṇaṃ karpāsaṃ natukaṃ patramañjarīñ ca /
/ cakrasya darśanārthaṃ karaṇaṃ gharmavātavarṣopadraveṇāspṛṣṭyai kūpagārasya dvāravanta /
/ nānuddiśya dvayaṃ śāstṛpūjāyāṃ datte bhikṣuṇīnāṃ sāṃghike praveśaḥ /
/ tasyaivātra sannipātagatam anuṣṭheyaṃ saṃghasthavireṇa mūlyasya karaṇam /
/ [48b3] datte kasyacid avibhakte vaṅgān mṛtau tadvargyagāmitvaṃ tadaṃśasya /
/ arhati nirvāṇāśayena pravrajitaḥ śīlavāṃ śatasāhasraṃ vastraṃ śatarasaṃbhojanaṃ pañcasūtaṃ kūṭāgāram /
/ na cel lābhasya pātracīvarād atirekass amā[48b6]dāpya /
/ nāsāṃghāṭyāṃ chinnādhiṣṭhānaniyamaḥ nāsatve tadrūpāṇāṃ pratyayānām icchanna[49a1] / /yā grāmāntargṛhayor anayopaveśaḥ praveśaś ca /
/ na lomasya viheṭhe syānyathā prāvṛtiṃ bhajet* /
/ adhiṣṭhāya tattvenānujñātā cīvaradhāraṇaṃ dhārayed uparāṃ vikalpānekam api /

/ samyaktvaṃ saṃkhyam anuktau sāhyasya vyayacāyanikṣeptre dānam
na sānikṣepte manonunmattakā tajñātitadgṛhādātuṃ pratigṛhṇīt* /
/ grahaṇaṃ punar labdhau staupikasya vṛtter mū[49a6]laphalekṣubhyo nyasya bhaktārthasyoddeśopajīvyasya vā bhājyatvaṃ svīkārāya /
/ nānavachinnaṃ bhojanam anulābhe bhikṣuṇīnāṃ bhuktavatve tatrāpraveśaḥ /
/ karaṇaṃ sabhikṣutāyām aśaktau teṣāṃ bhikṣuṇyā dakṣiṇādeśa[49b2]nasya sāmānyañ cārayiṣyatīti cārakam āhārasya pratyupasthitapādau dānāya saṃghasthaviro niyuñjīt /
/ yathāsaṃbhāvanam ity avalokya parṣadaṃ prabhūtyelpatve bhaktasya tadākhyānapūrvakaṃ /
/ na cānudghoṣite saṃprāptam iti vṛddhānta ādau gṛhṇīt /
/ pratidādyata ity ato nyena manasā saṃghaḥ pratigṛhṇīyāt /
/ pūrveṇa puṇḍakaccho nāma dāvaḥ purataḥ puṇḍavardhanasya /
/ sapta padāny antato gṛhiṇā paribhukte bahupuṭau api /
/ piṇḍībhavajjane ca janapade kholāṃ pūlāṃ ca /
/ kakṣahastikhaṭuṃkāś ca tadanyacaṇḍamṛgān<<ṇ>>ām apy ebhir ākṣepaḥ /
/ atrāpy atra tadrūpeṣv api pratyayeṣv ani[50a2]pattavyatā pratigṛhṇīt tarkṣacarma cakṣuṣe /
/ vāte niṣadyā nipadyā ca sarvam arśaḥsvetad ity asyopayogaḥ /
/ na nābhijñāstaraṇe kṛtvā savidhānam agādhamambho vagāhet* /
/ tadvac chuktaśulukadadhimaṇḍodaśvinmaṇḍakāni dakabhinnāni paṭṭapariśrutāni svacchāni mukhadarśīni śarakāṇḍavarṇāni /
/ ayuktiḥ prāg evaṃ [pa]ścād upasaṃpannena yarśanasya sa[50a5]mānavyaṃjanena /
/ atattvāt taddravyasya kālikaṃ ced anupasaṃpannena marddhanaṃ pariśrāvaṇañ ca paṭena /
/ tadasadatiriktakālāśritāvarūḍhiprāpte tasyāṃ cāgamyatvād bhaviṣyataḥ prākṛtānām anadhiṣṭheyatāpatteḥ /
/ candanaṃ cavikā padmakaṃ guḍūci devadāru haridrārdrakam /
/ tadyathā saindhavaṃ sauvarcalaṃ viṭaṃ sāmudraṃ romakam /
/ yāvad āptaṃ dānaṃ snātvā punarasaṃ sparṣaṃ sakṛt snānam iti kaṣāyadānam /
/ tadākhyaṃ punar uccāraprasrāvau stanyayānayāyināṃ vatsakānāṃ viṣe tāv upakārau /
/ jarakucoccārayavāścedakālopayojyatāyāṃ yācakṛtabhaiṣajyasya tadarthaṃ sphareyuḥ nānyāt paribhuñjīt /
/ sānye pi sadbhāvas tadadyācārasya tasmād pūrvakalpena tatsāhye pravṛttiḥ /
/ [50b6] nānāpannasya rūpāntaram apūrvarūpatvaṃ tasmān na visaṃpaccitasya parataḥ svakalpenākalpanam /
/ sampadyate prakṣālanena śaktataṇḍuleṣu pravṛttāvasthānasya svamātrasaṃkhyatā guḍasya /
/ svasaṃbhavatāṃ tatra bhārīkṛtya sūtaṃ vā nidhānam /
/ [51a3] anayaneta svayam upayātre vināśahetor abhāve nusaṃpannasya /
/ dvādaśāṅgulā sādhvī na tīkṣṇā puruṣā vā /
/ sthavikāyāṃ nidhānaṃ mrakṣayitvā sarpiṣā tailena vā /
/ apetatāyāṃ paligodhasya sthitatve ca manojñasya purataḥ khādyabhojyasya mokṣaḥ /
/ rakṣyas saṃsargas tasmād ūne vigatavegatāyāñ ca /
/ prāsādikañ ca sādhu tasmāc chuklanatrakena sūtīkaraṇam /
/ na laśunaṃ palāṇḍuṃ gṛñjanakaṃ vā paribhuñjīta /
/ nopayuñjanaḥ parataś ca saptāhaṃ laśune palāṇḍau trirātram ekarātraṃ gṛñjanavihāraṃ paribhuñjīt /
/ yāvantastā[va?]ntas sannihitāś caturthe saṃmaṃkalpikaśālām vāṅ bhāvakavacanodāhārataḥ /
/ tadyathā drākṣyadāḍimakharjūrākṣoṣṭau vātāma urumānarāmāpikākurumāyikānikocobabhūḥ piñcitikā[52a4]puṣkarañ ca tadākhyam /
/ yato nāgatiḥ śabdasya vihāre tatra kalpakāram āpanam /
/ nābhyām anupānapaṭṭakāc cānyat kaṃsabhājanaṃ pudgalo dhārayet /
/ grahaṇaṃ rakṣāyai pratipādyamānānām apy anyānāṃ samānavyañjanānām /
/ nāpārśvanihitatāṃ prāgāvāt pātra[52b2]sya piṇḍāya pravṛttau bhajet /
/ yathā vṛddhikayā [52b4] niṣādanāya dāpanāya ca mahāsannipāte bhikṣūṇām uddeśaḥ /
/ na yena mantrita tato 'nyasya labdheḥ svīkāre 'sty ayuktatvam /
/ nāntaṃ visarjayet [52b6] dṛṣṭiśīlasampannābhyāmāntasyānyatra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ dānam atiriktasya cālopād yātrākāriṇo grahaṇam /
/ māt[ā]pitṛglānaputrahyāpekṣakukṣīmatībhyo vineyākāṃ kṣāpiṇḍapātaṃ spṛṣṭavate gṛhiṇe ca saṃprāptāya saṃvibhāgaś ca tatḥ karaṇam /
/ na nimantraṇake śraddhadeyatvena pātrādhiṣṭhāne 'syocchiṣṭāśilāṃ yathā sukhakaraṇam /
/ śrāmaṇere ca sārddhaṃ paravadayoge kalpakārakānāṃ piṇḍīkṛtya dānam /
/ nedamito vā dehīti bhojanārtham upaviṣṭapariveṣṭāraṃ bodhayet /
/ tasmān mukham akāle pravāritaś codgārārāme nirmādayed anyaḥ /
/ adurgandhībhāvaprāṇakāsaṃbhavāya kālena kālaṃ śocanaṃ śoṣaṇañ ca /
/ nirdoṣaṃ śūte kukṣeḥ prāgantāt poccanamātraṃ kṛtvāsanaṃ nāto nyaḥ /
/ kalpikam aśaktau karmakārikāyānitīritaṃ tayā bhikṣuṇā kṛtam vacanam* /
/ na yasya kriyateḥ [54a5] tasmād asatvaṃ pūrakatvasya chandapariśuddhir vidheḥ /

/ tatsīmāntargatasyārhasya pūraṇe kāyataḥ chandato vā saṃniṣāde nanupraviṣṭatvaṃ pratikroṣantā ca yasya tatkarma tato nyasya pratikūlaṃ cet dharmaṃ vācyutasyeryāpathāt* pra[54b2]kṛtisthasya saṃyatasya vā cotsṛjyānabhijñasāntarāt* vyagratvaṃ /
/ aprakṛtisthatvam atra cānyatra vā karaṇīye karaṇīyakṛtau ca /
/ na niyamya kālaṃ paunaḥpunye nyatra vā /
/ yasya pūraṇe narhatva śalākācāraṇe pi tasya /
/ saṃghabhede sya rūḍhir anarhe na cāraṇe śalākāṇāṃ /
/ masūrikādau striyāḥ [54b6] vṛddhānte nanyatantratāyāṃ saṃghe sthitasya parārthe sapraṇatam* /
/ pātrabhaiṣajyaṃ vāme pāṇo pratisthāpya pratichādya dakṣiṇena pāṇinā /
/ rohanty asānnidhye cīvarasya manasā vikalpa utsarge dhiṣṭhānañ ca nānutsṛṣṭe pūrvatra /
/ ādau [55a2] ca triḥpragṛhītāṃ jalitvaṃ tādarthye divasārocane ca /
/ aupayikam ity ante svārthaṃ vijñaptena vacanaṃ pudgalaś cet /
/ ubhayasthatvam ekasminn e[55a4]katra pāde parasmin paratra /
/ na hāsyabhāvena kasyacit sthūlam arūḍhibuddhyā bhedotkṣepayoḥ /
/ nānyeṣāṃ nānāsaṃvāsikebhyo barhāṇāṃ pūraṇe gaṇena jñaptivācanayoḥ /
/ saṃpannatvaṃ [55a6] jñaptiśrutāv asya nāvidhir bhavyarūpe pratinidhinā dūtena pravrājanam /
/ na bhikṣubhikṣuṇītvayor anyakarmavastupratijñapite codakena kalpayati sāṃmukhyaṃ praṇidhikaraṇam /

/ akurvāṇasyāsyāgārikatīrthikadhvajadhāraṇatīrthyasevānācāracaraṇānyaśikṣaṇañ ca bhikṣuśikṣāyām utkacaprakacasya saṃghe roma pātayato niḥsaraṇaṃ pravarttayataḥ samīcīm upadarśayato viramato nimittād avasāraṇaṃ yācite /

/ tatkṣama[55b4]ṇakam atra karmaṇaḥ sthāne 'vasāraṇaṃ prati pratītāyām[ā]pattāvapratikṛtāyām apratikāryāyāṃ saṃvareṇādṛṣṭim udbhāvayantam anicchantaṃ pratikṛtim anuṣṭhātum anutsṛjantaṃ ca pāpikāṃ dṛṣṭim utkṣipeyuḥ /
/ ihaivainām āpattiṃ pratikurvīthā ayam eva tv āsaṃghaḥ prasrambhayiṣyati ity evaṃ brūyyuḥ /
/ sannihite tatrāsrame pratideśanīyasya garhyam āyuṣmantaḥ sthānam āpanno sātmyaṃ pratideśanīyanta dharmaṃ pratide[śa]yāmi iti /
/ tasmād arūḍhasyāsya pṛthak tadānīm utthāpyatā prathamaṃ ca /
/ nāsāṃ manye praṇidhātṝṇām avasāraṇasya praṇihitau rūḍhiḥ /
/ vikṛteḥ kriyamāṇapraṇidhinā dhvaste[56a5]na ca niṣkāsya mānena bhajane bhāṇḍasya choraṇam /
/ śuddhir ekasya purato deśanena saṃghāvaśeṣato hrīmataḥ /
/ apratītatve saṃghāvaśeṣāntardhāne [56b4] ntāsthitapratichādacittasyāśaktavattāyāṃ kṛtaṃ ne vā kiṃ* vā kīdṛśyaṃ ceti smartum anupasaṃpa katotkṣiptayoś cānutthānaṃ pratichādasya /
/ śodhite vastuni sāṣānuṣṭhānam anirjñāne pratichādakālasyāsaṃvya ānany ūnatvasya saṃśrayaṇaṃ /
/ aparimāna ity anirjñāne sya saṃśrayasaṃbahulāḥ parimānavatya iti prābhūtye /
/ carato paraprāksampannapraticikīrṣotpattau pṛ[tha]g* dānam ekaṃ caraṇaṃ /

/ naivoddeśaḥ /
/ avasāraṇena /
/ pūrvasya pra[57b2]kṛtigateḥ /
/ arhatvenottarasya /
/ prāg* dvāramokṣyād vihārādau ca paryuṣitavac caritapattau /
/ tathātaritapattau /
/ tathātarjitanigarhitaprathāsitapratisaṃkṛtotkṣiptāḥ /
/ naivoddeśaḥ /
/ varjanam evotkṣiptasyetaraiḥ /
/ anartatvañ ca tadātvanimittalābhe /
/ bhinnavat* /
/ tadvadbhinneṣv adharmapakṣyaḥ /
/ arūḍair aprakṛtistheṣu paripāsamānāpy aśikṣācaraṇānāṃ / [end of R om.]
/ na yatryānye triḥprabhṛtayaḥ sarvathā tadākhyacaraṇās tatra taccaret* /
/ [57b4] kalahakārakāgamanañ ca śrutvā bhayañ cedataḥ pratini[ḥ]sṛjetāṃ saṃghasannidhau pudgale vā /
/ chedas tadahorātrasya prakṛtisthena sārdham ekachadane parivāsikamānāsyacāriṇoḥ śayyāyāṃ bahi[ḥ]sīmni ca /
/ nāsannidhau tatsīmni śrāvyāṇām asyotthānaṃ nirdoṣaṃ tadaharā[57b5]gatau sīmāntare gamanam* /
/ na parivāsikena sārdham ekachadane pārivāsikaḥ śayīt* /
/ na tīrthyupanivāsasthasya tena sārdham atra doṣaḥ //
/ āgamaya tvam āyuṣmaṃ glānas tvam aprayojyama ity āyusmaṃ bhūteti glāno sāv ananuyojyā iti prativadeyuḥ /
/ savacanīyaṃ tv āyuṣman karomi na tvaṃ yo smādāvāsādanavalokya prakramitavyam asti me āyuṣmati praṇihitaṃ vacanāyeti /
/ karaṇam asyatra sthāpakaiḥ sthāpitasya tena [58a2] sārdham upasāraṇaṃ /
/ vakṣyāmy atrāmutra vā vase mutra vā vāstuni yatra ceṣṭam ity āropya cāmattiṃ* darśayitvāparādham utsṛjanena /
/ śīladṛṣṭyā cārājīva vipatyā sarvasyāsya codanādeḥ kriyāyāṃ ruḍhiḥ samūlakaṃ /
/ nāpoṣadhe tasya na kṛtau kṛtatve vā strītve sthāpakasyai[ka]tarasya puṃstve sthāpitatvaṃ sthāpitatā /
// na nānātvāya saṃghasya prabhāviṣṇum akā[58a4]maṃ codayed unmoṭayed vā codayatvaṃ /
/ na yatra prativirodhas tena sārdham abhinamane samāsīta /
/ dharme vinaye caitadvatām adharme ced abhiniveśo jñātvā saṃghasāmagrīn na vidyate /
/ tasmān na tad anyānāṃ saṃbhūya kṛtau karmaṇo rūḍhin na paraspareṇāvyagratvam* /
/ [58a5] kaliparāyaṇatva eṣā tadvipakṣasya cāvandyatvam idaṃ dharmabhiḥ /
/ mṛddhadvā vayam iti vadatsu yūtham api śramaṇāḥ śākyaputriyā sma ity ātmānam* [58a6] pratijānīdhve /
/ yeṣāṃ cedaṃ vṛttam iyaṃ vārtā kāruṇiko vaḥ śāstā yenaitad anujñātam etad api vo na prāpadyata iti prativadeyur anyatra /
/ nāpi sāritāām eṣāṃ sāmagyasya vinā sāmagrīlābhenotthāpanaṃ /
/ karmaṇaḥ kṛtāvadharmavādibhir antaḥsīmni pṛthak tadbhedo tadacittena /
/ sthalasthair atra sanni ced bhikṣuṇīnām acodyatvaṃ /
/ tat tatā yadīyasyotsaṃghe pratipādanaṃ [58b3] dvayoś ced ubhayatra /
/ arūḍhir asyāsaṃghaparimāṇatve bhidyamānānām asatve cānyeṣām antaḥsīmni saṃghaparisānānām adharmadharmayoḥ tathātvena pratyavagatāv ānantaryaṃ /
/ padārthatathātve vipratipattir varjanaṃ sāpattikā sāmagryadānaṃ karmāṇi /
/ tena sasthavire saprātimokṣe nyatra saṃgha upanikṣepaḥ /

/ anupadhūta idaṃ vadet teṣāṃ ca [59a2] āyuṣmanta alābhānālābhādurlabho na sulabhā ye yūyaṃ svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajyā kalahajātā viharata bhaṇḍanajātā vikṛhītā vivādam āpannām āyuṣmantaḥ kalaho mā bhaṇḍanaṃ vigraho mā vivādaḥ // nāsti dvayor yudhyato jaya ekasya jaya ekasya parājayaḥ / nāsti dvayor dhāvato jaya ekasya jaya ekasya parājaya [59a3] iti /
/ kharamarthipratyarthikair gṛhītatve pragāḍham* ca vyāḍhatve teṣāṃ bhedāśaṃkitāyām asya saṃsrayaṇaṃ /
/ sannipātāyārocanaṃ : saṃghe sarvaiḥ sannipati[ta]vyaṃ* / śalākāś cārayiṣyāmīti /
/ tathā ced adharmaśalākādhikyasaṃpattiṃ* [59a5] manyeta na chandānupradānena sāmagrye cārayeta /
/ dakṣiṇena pāṇinā dharmaśalākānāṃ cāraṇakāle grahaṇaṃ vāmenetarāsāṃ /
/ pratichādyaināś pūrvāḥ prakāśikṛtyopayācanam* / sthavire yaṃ dharmaśalākā ajihmā avaṃkā akuṭil[ā] su[va]rṇā sugandhā sukhasaṃsparśā gṛhāṇeti dvayor vācor itarāṃ mṛgaya tena prayacchet* /
/ yathā dharmodbhavam* [59a6] manyeta tathā cārayec channam vā vṛtaṃ vā /

/ āyusman, upādhyāyena te dharmaśalākā gṛhītā ācāryeṇa samānopādhyāyena samānācāryeṇāla[pta]kena na saṃlaptakena saṃstutakena sapremakena tvam api dharmaśalākaṃ gṛhāṇa mātretaiḥ sārdhaṃ virukṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti vā karṇamūle tantunāyaṃ /
/ na bhedodbhavakṣāntyā nādharmyasya na jānannayo bhaviṣyattāṃ /
/ nirvikriyasavikriyaś ca dviprakāraḥ prādeśikaḥ sakalasaṃghagataś ca /
/ bahūnām arthe trāsaṃghe deśyānām ekena pratikaraṇaṃ /
/ viparyayato dharmavinayatadviparyayāṇāṃ saṃghamadhye saṃcintyeti trikānvitaṃ codakam ādṛyeran /
/ saṃjñapanama saṃjñapanamarentaḥ piṭakānāṃ dhārayituran evaṃvidhasya samanuyuñjīrann enaṃ bhāvaḥ pratibodhāya sthānasthāpanena /
/ pratijñānaṃ coditena niṣṭhā dṛṣṭasatyatve prakṛṣṭataratve ca guṇato nyasya catuṣpramāṇīkaraṇaṃ gṛhiṇo pi /
anujāniyur anyeṣāṃ sāṃghike vastuni saṃghāya pudgalāya vā bhikṣave vāsavastu(na)karaṇaṃ /
/ nirdoṣam atadarthaṃ gatasya velāprāptau vihārāntare bhojanam* /
/ atiriktatāyāṃ bhikṣu mātrarthād grahaṇan na vihāram avyuperan* /
/ darśanamatirukṣaśaraṇapṛṣṭhaṃ mā tvaṃ jvarita iti [60a6] saṃjñayā khyāpanam ity atropāya[ḥ] /
/ utthāyaivāsau kālyam avalokayed vihāram* caityā[ṅ]ganaṃ ca /
/ [..] uccāraś cet tatkṛtaḥ chorayet* prasrāvaś ced u[ddhū]ṣennakharikābhilikhitaṃ cet samaṃ kuryāt* /
/ cāraṇe syaiṣāṃ vyāpāro bhukte ca gopane /
/ tadyathānyaśabdatayā bhojane susaṃvṛtatayā (//) supratichannatayā caityavandane yathāvṛddhikayā ca /
/ tat prathato bhuktvā vaṃsam ādāya kākacaṭakapāra([ta])tādīnāṃ bhuñjaneṣu tena vāraṇaṃ /
/ dvayaṃ paligodho bhakṣyamāṇena vā dantakāṣṭhād aśucinā vā tadbhūmiparikarmaṇāt* /
/ paligodha tatra nāgnyam ekacīvaratā cadevandane pañcamaṇḍalakena jaṃghaprapī[ḍa]nikayā ca /
/ na kṣut*vantaṃ jīv[e]ty abhivanded utsṛjyāntyāvayasamāgārikāṃ ca /
/ nāsya nirūpāpadaṃ nāma gotram vā gṛhṇīyāt* /
/ prārabdhasya ca vṛhatto lpasya vā karaṇārthaṃ bhañjanam* /
/ paścādbhaktaṃ taddāne kālo hemantaś ce[d] grīṣmaś ceti pūrvabhaktaṃ /
/ grahaṇāya saṃcāraṇe lohakaṇṭakānāṃ catu[61b3]ṣke py eṣu dānam /
/ sphuṭa(nā)naṃ kledaś ca kāṣṭhasya tasmād ayomayīnāṃ /
/ aupapādukānāṃ satvānāṃ ghaṭiyaṃtravaccyavamānānām upapadyamānānāṃ ca rāgadveṣamohānāṃ pārāvatabhujaṃgasūkarākāreṇa /
/ agniśālāyāṃ mecakādi kurvatām agniṃ* ca jvālayatāṃ kumbhāṇḍaputrāṇāṃ /
/ dānapater dīpaṃ dhārayato devadūti yasya ca /
/ nānālaṃkāravibhūṣitānāṃ kalaśa[hastā]nāṃ nāgakanyakānāṃ codakaṃ dhārayantīnāṃ pānīyamaṇḍape /
/ na vihāre nabhyavakāśe sadhūmam agniṃ* kuryād dhārayed dhārakuṭṭime sarvaṃ /
/ avaśiṣṭam aṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ ca sarvasaṃghe [62a6] gaṇḍīm ākoṭṭya dharmyayā vā kathayāryeṇa vā tūṣṇīmbhāvena /
/ dharmotsave sekaḥ sukumāryāś ca gomayakārṣāḥ pradānam* /
/ ratnārthaṃ saṃmṛṣṭāmṛṣṭayor gandhakūṭipratimācaityayaṣṭichayānāṃ cāryāṃ gāthāṃ paṭhatā laṃghaṇaṃ /
/ tathāpy ayogyatve gomayamṛdāstambhasuśire kuṇyasya vā lepanam* /
/ na dvārakoṣṭhake prāsāde vā śayyāprajñaptiṃ kṛtvā vā dhāraṇaṃ kuryāt* /
/ kuṭimāvināśārtham* [[62b3] maṇḍalam adhaḥpādakachedaṃ kāraye[nu]ṣamuṭake cainaṃ sthāpayen natukena vā veṣṭayet* /
/ nāpareṇe sārdham ekatra maṃce saṃ[s]tare nyatra vā /
/ kalpayed asaṃbhave lajjī pṛtha[k] pratyāsthī[tyā]ntare vṛṣikāpātrasthāvikādi dattvā smṛtim upasthāpya /
/ na trayād ūrdhaṃ pracitiḥ sāhyena maṃcarūḍhatāṃ bhajet* /
/ bhaje[d] āntargṛhe [62b5] upādhyāyenāpy āsanābhāve smṛtim upasthāpya /
/ saṃcāraṇe śayanāsanasya dvau ced ekena maṃcapīṭhasya vā grahaṇam apareṇa vṛśyādeḥ /
/ naita[tsā]ṃghikamadayam ākarṣenniṣkarṣed dhīna tathā kuryād yathāsya
/ ātapanaṃ sye śoṣaṇaṃ prasphoṭanaṃ chidrer gaḍakadānam* /
/ aśakyapratisaṃskaraṇatāyāṃ dīpeṣu viniyogo vartikātvena ratnopayogeṣu pudgaladātṛkeṣv api /
/ anupayajyamānasyātra kardamena bhittistambhakavāṭasuṣireṣu ratneṣu lepanam ity anupratipattiḥ /
/ na śa[63a2]kyaṃ sāṃghikam apaharantaṃ dṛṣ[ṭra] na nivārayet* /
/ na saty arthini kṛtakṛtya āvṛddhi bhojyam* dhāray[e]t* /
/ nārthisadbhāve satyāṃ gatau sāṃghikasya paliguddhatāṃ bhajet* /
/ nāpitabhāṇḍañ ca suktyāṃ prakṣipya bhitto sthāpanam* /
/ kṛtatām atra saṃvidhānasya upadhivārikaṃ saṃghasthaviraḥ pṛcchet* /
/ vihāramoṣe na ced baddhatvaṃ samāyuktair upadhivārikasya dāsya /
/ nābaddhvā yāvad bhāvaṃ bandhanaiḥ dvāraṃ prakrāmeta /

/ gṛhiṇaś ced atrāgaccheyur dharmyam ebhyaṣkathām anyac ca
śakyadharmaḥ kuryāt* /
/ gṛṣme syāś cedārtham apanayaḥ pūrvasyāpi varṣāḥ svakledāntam* /
/ kvacid dantakā[64a2]ṣṭhabhakṣyaṇam* kvacin mukhaśocanaṃ kvacit* pādayor ity evaṃ na tatprasṛtatayā /
/ pṛthag pravṛttyāpi pāṭhako bahutaropasthāpanakāriṇām aśakta sānukampet* /
/ na buddhavacanaṃ chandasi pade krame vā tatparāyaṇatayāropya paṭhita u[d]gṛhṇītad vahiḥ [64a4] śāstrāṇi samarthaḥ parasaṃjñapane anu[t]sṛjan buddhavacanābhiyogam* /
/ ārṣā gāthāṃ bhāṣaṇenainām abhimukhaṃ sthitvā saṃbo[64a5]dhyachaṭāśabdenāyanaprāpto 'nugṛhṇī[tā] /
/ tadbhāṇḍa samutsṛjya śastrakośaṃ sūcīgṛhakaṃ melaṃdukaṃ ca /
/ gacchet tadrūpeṣu pratyayeṣu prativihāre sāv upadrave vyapadiśya /

/ tathāgatapā[rśva]deśavaivṛttatā cet tasyāṃ diśi karaṇaṃ yatraiṣāṃ
tatparivāradāne ca sthānam abhūt* /
/ na kaṇṭakānāṃ ropa[ṇa]ṃ nāgadantakānāṃ māsasaṃyojanāya dānam uttiṣṭhati /
/ noparidīpadānaṃ āgārikaiṣpūjanārtham adhirohaṇam abhāve śramaṇodd[e]śaiṣpādo prakṣālya gandhodakena /
/ na ced anena gandhair udvartya vastreṇa vā veṣṭayitvā śāstu saṃjñāmāmukhīkṛtyārtham abhidhyāya smṛtaiḥ /
/ [65a1] // navakeṣv asya prāptiḥ paṃcabhiḥ nikāyaiḥ parivāradānaṃ /
/ vāditreṇaitadvādyamānena sār[d]vanyena ca mahatā sa[t]kāreṇa nirāvadyaṃ vādanāya kuru kuru bhoṣ puruṣa [śāstu]ḥ pūjām ity udīraṇam* /
/ udghoṣaṇaṃ rathyāvīthica[phva?] sṛṅgāṭakeṣu śvaḥ paraśvo vā bhaviṣyattāyāṃ likhitasya iti buddhapraveśo bhaviṣyatīti bhujādāvāropitasya [65a2] hastiskandhe cha[tra]dhvajapatākāparivṛtasya /
/ dhvajair asyāḥ parivāro vedikayāveṣṭanam* lohastambheś ca /
/ samāptāyāṃ pūjāyāṃ nirvṛteṣu vādyeṣu viprakrānte janakāye maṇḍanāpanamanam* /

bhojanaṃ bījāghātaṃ ca deśe ca harite śuciḥ //
utsargaṃ vṛkṣārohaś ca śaikṣā u[65a5]ddeśāyos saha /
ratnasparśanabhukyā ca jātas sāṃnidhyānāntayoḥ //
bhūmiprarohaghātābhyām utsṛjyānta ca sūtragataṃ /
pravṛṣe katra vasanaṃ poṣadhas sapravāraṇāḥ //
ityādy asyāntabhāg liṅga yāñcā bhāṇḍopabhugdrava kāmopabhoga saṃvāsānād
arāśodhakavastukam /
sparśapañjaranikṣepau pratichādo nivāraṇam /
trayaṃ kiṃcitkacatuṣṭayaṃ [65a6] gaṇamṛtasīmni ratnataḥ //
chandasaṃmṛṣṭasaṃsparśāc catuṣṭayaṃ bhavati paścimam /
vidhāraṇaṃ saptakaṃ dve cānye dhāraṇādhiṣṭhānoddhārānuddhāra iti //

saṃkṣepasyānvananuvyabhiśokabhaṇḍanam /

saṃtagradhāraṇaṃ /
gṛhe channe layane mañce udvarttanamaṃcaka unmuroṭikā gandhapiṇyākataḥ /
snāośīraphalakurvatriśīrṣāṇāṃ kārṇaṅ kāravṛddhādi /
chatropānaha āsandī niṣādārikarttanaṃ coḍā // vikrayagṛhapaticyutvā lasuna

sapatha vyathanāvasyaṇḍanakrośānasekāvyupaśayanataḥ /
chandāvavādapoṣadhavarṣaprāvaraṇakaṭhinoddhārabhājanavarṣākā[la?]caryācara-
ṇavādaḥ /

pravāraṇagate cātra sarvasminn ardhapañcake //

dāne vstrasya gaṇān catuṣke kulasamvṛti /
tatprasrabdhyau kubje ca sonmajje jñaptimātrakaṃ //

śalākam vārakānāṃ vihārakuṭideśane /
codakasyāpravāsāya sanmetaṣyā tra cāriṇāḥ //
aprasādapravedāvavaditrorvanavedinaḥ /
avandanānalārthaṃ ca daṇḍaśikṣārtham eva ca //
ekalābhakriyāyāñ ca śikṣaṇā na samu[65b5]pasthite /
putre jñātau bahiryāne jñapanaṃ śaikṣyāvāsanaṃ //
